module: Lua interface layer to the C++ node editor (Engine.fge, an "imgui-node-editor" style graph editor). The file returns a function that receives a table M (that of ui_flowgraph_editor) and adds to it: identifier constructors (NodeIdPtr, LinkIdPtr, PinIdPtr), enums (StyleColor_*, StyleVar_*, PinKind_*, FlowDirection_*, IconType_*, Dirty_*), and wrappers of the fge functions (current editor, styles, nodes, pins, links, selection, creation/deletion, navigation, shortcuts, context menus, screen/canvas conversion). It is not a loadable extension by itself.
notes: Begin() adjusts the ImGui scale: SetWindowFontScale(1/FontGlobalScale) and sets im.uiscale[0] to 1; End() restores im.uiscale[0] and resets the font scale to 1.
GetSelectedNodes/GetSelectedLinks are deprecated: they log an error and fill a 0-based array from GetSelectedNodeIds/GetSelectedLinkIds.
M.setDebugEnabled is assigned to fge.getDebugEnabled (not to a setter): probable copy-paste bug, setDebugEnabled reads instead of writing.

Default values are applied by the wrappers: Link (white color, thickness 1, isShortcut false), BeginCreate, QueryNewLink2/QueryNewNode2/AcceptNewItem2/RejectNewItem2 (thickness 1), AcceptDeletedItem (deleteDependencies true), SelectNode/SelectLink (id 0, append false), NavigateToContent (duration -1), NavigateToSelection (zoomIn false, duration -1).
M.ctx is initialized with fge.GetCurrentEditor() if an editor exists; SetCurrentEditor also updates M.ctx.

PtrToId.desc: Returns the numeric identifier of a NodeId/LinkId/PinId pointer object (calls obj:id()).

NodeIdPtr.desc: Creates a NodeId object initialized to 0.

LinkIdPtr.desc: Creates a LinkId object initialized to 0.

PinIdPtr.desc: Creates a PinId object initialized to 0.

SetCurrentEditor.desc: Sets the current editor (M.ctx and fge.SetCurrentEditor).

PopStyleColor.desc: Pops editor style colors (1 by default).

PopStyleVar.desc: Pops editor style variables (1 by default).

Begin.desc: Opens the node editor canvas (fge.Begin) and neutralizes the ImGui UI scale for the duration of the editing.

End.desc: Closes the canvas (fge.End) and restores the UI scale.

Link.desc: Declares a link between two pins.

Flow.desc: Animates a flow on a link.

BeginCreate.desc: Starts the interactive link/node creation section.

AcceptDeletedItem.desc: Accepts the deletion of the queried item.

deleteDependencies.desc: Also deletes dependencies, true by default.

append.desc: Adds to the selection, false by default.
Adds to the selection, false by default.

NavigateToContent.desc: Centers the view on all the content.

NavigateToSelection.desc: Centers the view on the selection.

GetSelectedNodes.desc: Deprecated: logs an error; fills nodes (0-based) with the selected ids.

GetSelectedLinks.desc: Deprecated: logs an error; fills links (0-based) with the selected ids.
